intent: A curving terrace of ivory singing statues in ranks around a gold-veined orchestra, their song made visible as a pillar of light at its centre; new because the game has no terraced choir of assembly-built figures, no song-ray floor and no gilded colonnade-crowned bank.

critic.best_shot: feature-shots-final: ranks of figures round the gold pillar
critic.why: Strong ring silhouette and a great light-pillar set piece; the singers read as raised hands, not choristers.

role: Side court: choir ring with its light pillar as a mid-map beacon.
notes:
# C

Keep: Keep the ring of ranked figures round a single gold pillar and the song-light beam.

1. Give the choristers heads and open mouths or robes so they read as singers, not hands on posts.
2. Clean the bank: the ring of jagged fragments reads ruined; the Domain wants whole terraces.
3. Vary the arc more per seed (two facing banks, a horseshoe) so seeds differ in route.
